The settings tfl_ai_prepare() kept with a study

Source: R/ai_prepare_yml.R
tfl_ai_prepare_settings.Rd

Reads ai/prepare.yml of the study folder: the arguments of the last tfl_ai_prepare() call that wrote the requests, as that function takes them, for tfl_ai_prepare() (tfl_ai_prepare(dir) repeats them) and for a screen that fills its fields from them.

Usage

tfl_ai_prepare_settings(dir)

Arguments

dir

The study folder.

Value

A named list of the settings, the paths absolute again (a path of the file that is relative is from dir), toc_cols a list; with the attributes file (the file's path), written and tflspec – or NULL when the study has no ai/prepare.yml. The paths are not checked.

Details

The file is plain YAML, keys in a fixed order, strings quoted, the version: of the format first (1), then written: (the date-time) and tflspec: (the version that wrote it), then the settings under the argument names of tfl_ai_prepare():

  • paths – toc, shells, adam, adam_spec, define, docs: from the study folder, with forward slashes, when inside it; else as given (absolute);

  • toc_sheet, sheets, toc_cols, sheet_roles, study_id, title, size, language, workbook, max_chars, unit, templates, area, datasets, max_levels, agent_reads, agent_max_reads: the values; a list (sheets, shells, docs, datasets, agent_reads) is a YAML list, toc_cols and sheet_roles a YAML map.

Only the arguments the call was given are in the file; a key that is missing is the argument's default. Left out: dir, overwrite, dry_run, quiet, progress and add (they describe the call, not the settings), adam_summary (an R object) and numbers (a data frame: ai/sheet_numbers.csv keeps the result and the next call reads it); a value that is not plain text, numbers or TRUE / FALSE is left out too, and named in a comment of the file. With add = TRUE the file keeps the study's first workbook's settings (toc, toc_sheet, sheets, shells, toc_cols, sheet_roles, unit); the other settings the call gave replace the file's, and docs, agent_reads and datasets are joined (in order, once each). A study with no file, add = TRUE: none is written. The agent does not read the file.

See also

tfl_ai_prepare()

Examples

d <- file.path(tempdir(), "no-prepare-yml")
tfl_ai_prepare_settings(d)
#> NULL
